questions.stem: What happens during anaphase of mitosis?

options.text: The nuclear membrane reforms around each set of chromosomes
The chromosomes condense and become visible
The sister chromatids are pulled apart to opposite poles of the cell by spindle fibres
The chromosomes line up along the middle of the cell

questions.explanation: During anaphase, the spindle fibres shorten and pull the sister chromatids apart, moving one copy of each chromosome to opposite ends (poles) of the cell.
